description: Calculate the exact transmission coefficient of a one-dimensional rectangular potential barrier for an electron, proton or alpha particle, below or above the barrier height. Give particle energy and barrier height in eV and barrier width in nm; the result adds the WKB exponential estimate, the thick-barrier asymptote and the decay length. Textbook closed form (OpenStax University Physics 3, 7.6) with CODATA 2018 masses; a single square barrier only, no band structure or image-charge effects.

energy_ev.description: Particle kinetic energy in eV, greater than 0.

height_ev.description: Barrier height in eV, greater than 0.

width_nm.description: Barrier width in nm, 0 or more.

name: quantum_tunnelling
title: Quantum tunnelling through a rectangular barrier
